population: PC-001 through PC-075, original registry order
algorithm: Sort IDs by SHA256(UTF8(str(seed) + ":" + claim_id)); take first 15. This is deterministic pseudorandom priority sampling without replacement.

judgement_rules.supported: Source page supports the paraphrase, all assigned cells, and stated scope.
judgement_rules.partially_supported: Core idea supported but a qualifier, scope condition, or cell needs correction.
judgement_rules.unsupported: Source contradicts or does not support the substantive claim.
judgement_rules.unlocatable: The specified version/page/passage cannot be located.

error_rate_rule: Report all four category counts. Any issue is an error; unlocatable is a separate unresolved count. Never infer a zero error rate from blank forms.
